title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
prompt:
Design a dictionary supporting wildcard search:

- `WordDictionary()`
- `void addWord(String word)`
- `boolean search(String word)` — `word` may contain `.`, which matches any single letter

A trie handles the letters; the `.` wildcard forces a branch: try every child at that position (DFS).

tests.note: single-letter wildcard, and length must match

hints: Build a trie (26-way children + isEnd). addWord is the standard trie insert.
search recurses with an index into the word and the current node.
On a normal letter, descend that one child. On `.`, try DFS into EVERY non-null child; succeed if any branch matches.

solution.explanation: addWord and non-wildcard search are O(word length). A `.` multiplies the search by branching into up to 26 children, so worst-case search is O(26^(dots)) — fine because the tree prunes dead branches immediately (missing children return false at once).
